title: MicroCLI Petal: self-service ops CLI with dry-run policies and runbook compilation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, self-service CLI (MicroCLI Petal) that lets SREs and Support run common admin tasks locally or from CI with enforced dry-run and policy gates. The CLI compiles high-level command invocations into runbook-as-task artifacts (the same format the runbook executor consumes), validates them against org policies, simulates execution (dry-run) producing a replayable plan, and emits telemetry and provenance to console and the Console service. Goal: reduce mean time to remediate for routine fixes while preventing accidental live changes for non-privileged flows.
user_stories: As a junior oncall I want to run a 'collect-logs' command without risk, so I can gather data before escalating.
As a support engineer I want a safe 'canary-restart' that runs in dry-run and shows exact node selection and commands that would be executed.
As an SRE I want the CLI to compile commands into runbook tasks and attach a policy evaluation report so audits show approved vs blocked steps.
acceptance_criteria: MicroCLI binary (linux/darwin) builds and installs via brew/tar and exposes core verbs: collect-logs, restart-service, rotate-keys, run-playback
Every invocation supports --dry-run which emits a deterministic execution plan JSON compatible with runbook executor schema
Policy gate evaluates against org admission rules; blocked steps are surfaced and prevent live execution
All non-dry-run executions require a permission token and emit provenance metadata to Console (who/what/timestamp/plan-hash)
End-to-end tests cover dry-run vs live-run for two canonical ops flows and simulated failure modes
progress_updates: 2026-02-04: Spike completed — prototyped compile->executor JSON using current runbook schema; found missing step type 'select-group' which requires a schema extension (see notes)
2026-02-06: Policy team reviewed admission hooks; agreed on a lightweight JSON policy report format. Need to reconcile with Console ingestion contract.
2026-02-08: UX review with Support: added explicit confirmation step for 'restart-service' when node count > 3. Feedback captured in design doc.
2026-02-10: IAM integration stubbed; non-dry-run flow blocked until token exchange implemented. Work continues on telemetry shape.
decisions: Implement compile-first model: CLI compiles into runbook JSON then optionally posts to executor — avoids dual-code-path bugs
Dry-run will be deterministic and store plan-hash (sha256) so Console can detect drift between dry-run and live execution
Policy evaluation will be synchronous for CLI flows; asynchronous policy enforcement (webhooks) deferred to follow-up
tradeoffs: Sync policy evaluation increases latency for CLI but provides immediate feedback to users — acceptable for human-initiated flows
Bundling the runbook schema change increases scope but reduces long-term impedance between CLI and executor — chosen to avoid schema mismatch later
risks: Mistyped CLI verbs could compile into destructive runbooks if policy gate fails — mitigated via strict dry-run-by-default and strong confirmation UI
Schema evolution risk: existing runbook executors may reject new step types — added compatibility shim in executor PR
Telemetry GDPR/audit concerns for log collection commands — will add sensitive-data redaction rules in telemetry pipeline
qa_plan: E2E harness that runs CLI dry-run and posts to a sandbox executor; verify plan / audit events
Chaos test: inject partial permission revocation mid-execution to verify safe abort
rollout_plan: Canary: internal SREs opt-in with feature flag for 2 weeks
Phase 2: open to oncall rotation with telemetry monitoring for false-block rates
GA: enable for Support with training doc and 24h rollback window
follow_up_tasks: Add async policy webhooks and allow pre-approval flows (ENG-?)
Integrate microcli into CI runbooks for automated remediation (create ENG ticket)
Create runbook migration guide for existing ad-hoc scripts
notes: Prototype showed ~150ms compile time for typical 6-step flows; acceptable
Need a small schema bump to represent 'selection-expression' for node groups — coordinated with runtime team
PM asked to track MTTR delta after internal pilot — include dashboard measure in Console
